subject: [PATCH v2 4/4] fs/proc/task_mmu: account device-private PMDs as present in smaps

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)
reviews.summary: Provided a Reviewed-by tag without any specific comments or suggestions.

2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch series addresses an issue where device-private PMDs are not accounted for in the smaps output, leading to incorrect PSS and private/shared mapping counts. The fix involves modifying the smaps_pmd_entry function to mark device-private PMDs as present.
